use_case_name: Share a Geographic Pointer with Other Units

claims.content: To enable a C2 JU to share a specific Geographic Pointer with other units, allowing them to rapidly access the associated indicator and data messages for that location.

goal.raw_text: To enable a C2 JU to share a specific Geographic Pointer with other units, allowing them to rapidly access the associated indicator and data messages for that location.

claims.content: The C2 JU receives a J7.0 (ACT = 6) Geographic Pointer Report message.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU receives a J7.0 (ACT = 6) Geographic Pointer Report message.

claims.content: The C2 JU receives a J7.0 (ACT = 6) Geographic Pointer Report message.
The C2 JU sets up its display to show the new Geographic Pointer and associated data.
The C2 JU transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 6) message containing the new Geographic Pointer ID and data to other units via the appropriate interface(s).
Other units receive the J7.0 (ACT = 6) message and update their displays accordingly.
The receiving C2 JU has set up its display to show the new Geographic Pointer and associated data.
Other units have received the J7.0 (ACT = 6) message containing the new Geographic Pointer ID and data.
Other units have updated their displays to reflect the new Geographic Pointer.
